independent_derivation_or_calculation: Independent verification from first principles: 1. Blackbody radiation thermodynamics: Energy density u(T) = a T^4 with radiation constant a = 4 sigma / c = 7.5657e-16 J/(m^3 K^4). Dimension of u: [M L^-1 T^-2]. Dimension of a: [M L^-1 T^-2 Theta^-4]. Homogeneous. 2. Photon kinematics: Photons satisfy relativistic dispersion E = p c. Kinetic theory in 3 dimensions gives isotropic pressure P = (1/3) int p c n(p) dp = (1/3) u = (1/3) a T^4. Contrast with non-relativistic gas P = (2/3) u_kin. 3. Reversible adiabatic expansion: dQ = d(u V) + P dV = 0 => u dV + V du + P dV = 0. Since du = 4 a T^3 dT and u + P = (4/3) a T^4, we obtain 4 a V T^3 dT + (4/3) a T^4 dV = 0 => dT/T + (1/3) dV/V = 0. Integrating gives ln(T) + (1/3) ln(V) = const => T^3 V = const, or T V^(1/3) = const. 4. Spherical geometry: V = (4/3) pi R^3 proportional to R^3 => T (R^3)^(1/3) = const => T R = const. Verified.
verification_notes: All relativistic photon gas dynamics, radiation pressure relations, Stefan-Boltzmann energy densities, adiabatic scaling laws (T^3 V = const, T R = const), and dimensional consistencies verified from first principles. Explains cosmological redshift and cosmic microwave background temperature scaling accurately.
findings: Radiation pressure P = u/3 derived from ultra-relativistic photon dispersion E = pc in 3D.

Scaling relations T^3 V = const, T V^(1/3) = const, and T R = const confirmed.
